name: [Fixes] POLYBATTLE
desc:
⭐️ EXCLUSIVE GUN SKIN for 400k LIKES, HELP US WITH YOUR SUPPORT⭐️
⭐️ Update July,23 2022 ⭐️
💥 A NEW MODE IS HERE. PLAY MIL-SIM MODE IN OUR NEWEST MAP, VIETNAM
💥 2 NEW GUNS AND A NEW TANK ONLY AVAILABLE IN THIS MODE.
💥 2 New Maps are added for King of The Hill Mode.
💥 Gun Selection UI is improved. Select Attachments & Skins before deploy.
💥 Huge bug fixes and sight corrections, usual stuff
POLYBATTLE is a first-person shooter BATTLE Exp made with low-poly style. Two teams compete against each other and try to control the majority of the objectives.

🔥POLYBATTLE FEATURES🔥
💫 7 BATTLE READY CLASSES
💫 DOZENS OF BATTLEGROUNDS
💫 20 DIFFERENT WEAPONS
💫 ADVANCED WEAPON ATTRIBUTES
💫 DOZENS OF MILITARY VEHICLES
💫 HIGH LEVEL CUSTOMIZATION
